title: Google announces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model
summary: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a video-generation model from Google DeepMind that it claims is faster and 30% cheaper to run. Users can generate 360p or 720p drafts at $0.07 per second and then upscale them to 1080p or 4K. The model produces clips of up to 15 seconds, with selectable durations from 3 to 15 seconds, and supports conversational edits to backgrounds, subjects, and lighting, plus multi-speaker audio and lip-sync improvements and more controllable camera motion with fewer jump cuts. The supplied item does not include availability details or independent benchmarks; the performance and pricing details are Google&\#x27;s official claims.
